author: Exe139
quote: GTA VI is a disappointing example of an industry that prioritizes hype, corporate greed and brand recognition over genuine innovation. Repetitive gameplay, graphical inconsistencies and performance issues are unacceptable considering the game’s budget and development **** near-perfect critic scores are particularly questionable when reviews acknowledge significant flaws yet award perfect ratings. It raises serious concerns about the integrity of modern gaming journalism and its relationship with major publishers.Rockstar should be held to the same standards as every other developer. A recognizable franchise and an enormous marketing budget should never excuse mediocrity.
